content: अनुदार {%a.%} .²1 Not liberal, niggardly; not high or noble. .²2 Having none more liberal, very liberal, or great.

अनुदार {%a.%} (अनुगतो दारान्) .²1 Adhering to or followed by a wife; यस्मिन्प्रसीदसि पुनः स भवत्युदारोऽनुदारश्च <ls>K. P. 4</ls>. (used in sense .²1 also). .²2 Having a suitable or worthy wife (अनुरूपाः दाराः यस्य).
